chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

'Isa ibn Maryam (peace be upon him) arose to address the Children of Israel, and he said: "O Children of Israel! Do not speak words of wisdom to the ignorant, for you would be doing injustice to those words; and do not withhold wisdom from those who deserve it, for you would be doing injustice to them."'

key_terms.أَهْلَهَا: Its people/those who deserve it — those who are prepared, qualified, and genuinely seeking to receive wisdom.
key_terms.الْجُهَّالَ: The ignorant — those lacking the spiritual and intellectual preparation to receive and properly understand wisdom.
key_terms.الْحِكْمَةِ: Wisdom — in Islamic tradition, this refers to sacred, divinely-inspired knowledge, not merely prudential reasoning. It appears in the Quran (2:269) as a divine gift granted to whom God wills.

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Jesus say about sharing wisdom with the ignorant?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) narrates a teaching attributed to Prophet Jesus (AS), who instructed the Children of Israel about the proper dispensation of wisdom. The hadith articulates a two-sided principle: sharing sacred knowledge indiscriminately with the ignorant demeans and wastes it, while withholding it from those genuinely seeking it wrongs the seekers. This principle was particularly resonant in a context where religious knowledge was strictly transmitted through qualified masters to prepared students.
word_analysis: for you would be wronging it
for you would be wronging them

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa Bin Ubeyd, from Yunus Bin Abdul Rahman, from the one who mentioned it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Isa<sup>as</sup> Bin Maryam<sup>as</sup> arose to address among the Children of Israel, so he<sup>as</sup> said: ‘O Children of Israel! Do not be narrating the (words of) wisdom to the ignorant for you would be doing injustice to these (words), and do not be preventing it from its deserving ones, for you would be doing injustice to them’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa ibn ‘Ubayd from Yunus ibn ’Abd al-Rahman from the person who he mentioned from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) who has said the following.

“Jesus, son of Mary (a.s.) once stood up to speak to the Israelites saying, ‘O Israelites, do not speak the words of wisdom to the ignorant people because you will be doing injustice to them (words of wisdom). Do not keep them (words of wisdom) from those who deserve lest you will do injustice to them (deserving people).’”
